plugin.name: Android
plugin.description: Android apps: finds app modules in Gradle builds, checks the Android SDK, picks a device or boots an emulator, installs and runs the app with live logcat
opt.device.info: Leave empty to choose automatically: the only connected device, or the only emulator when nothing is connected. Emulators start with a window and keep running after the run stops.
opt.activity.info: Leave empty to resolve the app's launcher activity. Accepts .MainActivity, a full class name, or package/class.
opt.forceStop.info: Runs am force-stop on the device when the run is stopped.
setting.emulatorArgs.info: Extra arguments for the emulator, split like a shell command line, e.g. -no-snapshot-load or -gpu host.
